claimBoundary: deterministic synthetic conformance harness only; not acoustic, signed-app, physical-device, blinded-listening, CPU, memory or production evidence

determinism.generator: integer phase accumulators, integer LCG noise and IEEE-754 little-endian packing; no platform DSP or private/user audio
determinism.artifactNames: lowercase case-id and role only; no user, device, title, path or transcript metadata

nearEndOnly.finalSTOIMethod: canonical STOI implementation over the clean near-end reference and processed capture; required by final C3, not replaced by the CI correlation sentinel

processor.cpuAndMemoryStatus: thresholds frozen for exact-build platform adapters; synthetic self-test values are not physical evidence

workflowRouteMatrix.rule: each candidate adapter reports every applicable case independently; results are never averaged across workflow, route or platform

candidateArtifact.cellRule: one candidate bundle is exactly one platform, exact build, workflow and resolved route cell; a report cannot be reused or averaged across cells
candidateArtifact.outputEncoding: one exact-length relative .f32le output per fixture with declared SHA-256
candidateArtifact.caseReceipt: each case binds id, output, SHA-256 and content-free lifecycle events; route/device/reference reconfiguration reports rearmed or terminated_unsupported
candidateArtifact.pathRule: resolved output stays below the candidate artifact directory; symlinks, absolute paths and traversal are rejected

retention.syntheticFixtures: generated under a caller-owned temporary directory and safe to delete immediately after the report
retention.candidateOutputs: delete after report hashing unless explicitly retained as non-user synthetic CI evidence
retention.humanAudio: forbidden in this harness; manual epic uses consented purpose-built fixtures and expires audio after aggregate review
retention.report: retain hashes, categorical failures, aggregate metrics and toolchain receipt only

requiredLater: signed Windows and macOS exact-build adapters
physical speaker, headphone, Bluetooth and external-device routes
true acoustic echo paths and route changes
canonical STOI and blinded listening with at least three independent listeners
physical CPU, memory, latency, indicator and accessibility evidence
